name_input: M/S ASIAN CONTEC LIMITED; ASIAN CONTEC LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey (https://importkey.com/countries/india/asian-contec-limited) shows 1292 records, but every visible row has ASIAN CONTEC LIMITED in the BUYER column, e.g. "2026-02-22 | IDS GEORADAR S.R.L | ASIAN CONTEC LIMITED | POSITIONING KIT FOR CHASER,XR (ACCESSORIES FOR SURVEYING INSTRUMENT) | MILAN MALPENSA, ITALY -> DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 39269099 | BOL 7684239". No row was seen with Asian Contec as supplier/exporter to a foreign destination. Source counter: page claims "Total Shipments 1292 Records detected"; rows actually seen in the free view = 5 (all imports).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. Web search (DuckDuckGo via searx) returned connection errors on every attempt; Bing/Google returned only generic 'Asia' results; asiancontec.com did not resolve (DNS error); volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403. No domestic supply record was seen, but absence of a searchable source is not proof of absence.
note: Import-side activity is real and recent (customs B/Ls dated 2026-02-07 to 2026-02-22, Delhi Air Cargo, HS 39269099 / 90318000 / 84719000 / 90249000), so the company is an active importer/distributor of surveying and testing instruments (georadar, locators, hardness testers) from IDS GeoRadar, Rycom, Komplex, Sisgeo. Declared HS 902480 (hardness/strength testing machines) is broadly consistent with the imported goods line "HARDNESS/STRENGTH TESTING INSTRUMENT" (HS 90249000 parts), but no export under any HS was found. No export shipments, no B/L with Asian Contec as shipper, no destination outside India observed. Domestic supply: no traces of supplies found in accessible public sources — status unknown rather than confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in free views). Note the entity is described as 'Limited' but the ImportKey address is B-28, Okhla Industrial Area-I, New Delhi; corporate status/CIN not verified in this pass (registries out of scope).
